layout.structure: candid seminar photo with projection screen as focal point

projection_screen.content: THESE ARE WARNING SIGNS OF BAD COLLAGEN
projection_screen.screen_type: pull-down projector screen on tripod stand
projection_screen.screen_color: bright white with slight warm cast from room lighting

pose.gesture: right hand pointing/gesturing toward screen text

audience.visible: back of one person's head in bottom foreground
audience.role: creates voyeuristic 'you are in the room' perspective

details: round table with white tablecloth visible

photography.angle: audience POV, slightly low, looking up at presenter
photography.depth_of_field: medium - screen and presenter sharp, foreground audience soft

color_story.dominant: warm neutrals - beige walls, white screen, black blazer

the_vibe.energy: insider knowledge being shared in exclusive setting
the_vibe.scroll_stop_factor: looks like a real photo from an event you missed - FOMO + curiosity about 'warning signs'
the_vibe.psychological_hook: authority figure + bold claim on screen = must-know information

must_keep: projector screen with bold text as primary focus
professional female presenter gesturing at screen
audience member in foreground for perspective
warm intimate room setting (not corporate stage)

layout.structure: street portrait with subject holding handwritten sign as focal text

background.color: muted warm tones, desaturated city colors

red accent bar and red CTA button
